Title: How to properly play out-of-turn masters

Messages.Author: 1muflon1
Messages.Body:
Hi, I have a question about out-of-turn masters. I always thought out-of-turn masters must be played out of your turn but then I saw the text of the Path of Tear, which states:

"Master: out-of-turn. Path.
Put this card on a Salubri when you move that Salubri from your uncontrolled region to your ready region during your influence phase. If you burned 3 or more pool for the scarce penalty for this vampire, you gain 3 pool. Cards that require Obeah [obe] cost this Salubri 1 less blood. Any minion may burn this card as a  action. A vampire can have only one path."

It says that it should be put on a salubri when I move it out of an uncontrolled region to my ready region during my influence phase but it is out-of-turn and my influence phase is my turn. Is it possible to play out-of-turn masters during my turn outside my master phase or am I missing something here?

Thanks in advance for help!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> 1muflon1 wrote:
> Hi, I have a question about out-of-turn masters. I always thought out-of-turn masters must be played out of your turn
>
Correct, unless the card itself allows you to play it also during your turn (eg. Ebony Fox Hunt) or if the timing written on it leads to play it during your turn (eg. Path of Tear).

Name: Ebony Fox Hunt
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Master: out-of-turn.
Cancel a blood hunt called on a Black Hand vampire you control. You may play this card during your turn.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
> 1muflon1 wrote:
> It says that it should be put on a salubri when I move it out of an uncontrolled region to my ready region during my influence phase but it is out-of-turn and my influence phase is my turn
>
.
That is because you play regular master cards only during your master phase.

Path of Tears is being played on your influence phase during which you aren't allowed to play master cards. However, since it is out-of-turn master that specifically states that you can play it "on a Salubri when you move that Salubri from your uncontrolled region to your ready region during your influence phase."

> 1muflon1 wrote:
> Is it possible to play out-of-turn masters during my turn outside my master phase or am I missing something here?
>
Only of the card specifically allows it.
